description: Presidential Secretariat - Resignation from offices of Ministries
categorisation: This gazette exclusively announces the resignations of two named individuals (Hon. Harin Fernando and Hon. Malik Samarawickrema) from their ministerial offices. It provides only their basic titles (e.g., "Minister of Telecommunication...") without detailing their specific portfolio responsibilities or describing any structural changes to the government. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
